decisions.evidence: R2 maker direction-summary omits tag autocomplete ('tags, full search, notes... without creating duplicates'). R2 client: 'with tags, when I'm typing one I'd like it to suggest tags I've already used, so I don't end up with slightly different versions of the same tag.' Later presented R11.
decisions.note: Specification-gate (direction check). Presented scope lacked the reference autocomplete requirement; client surfaced it as a related missing requirement -> extend. Divergence established from the omission independent of the request.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker summary omits sorting. R2 client: 'with search, I want to be able to sort the results too — by when I added them, or by title.' Later presented R23.
decisions.note: Direction gate. Reference sort requirement missing from presented scope; client requested it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker save-flow prototype presents an enriched card only, no editing ('I've assumed a single prominent paste box and a card showing...'). R4 client: 'I'm assuming the title and description will be things I can edit if the auto-collected version isn't quite right... just keep it in mind.' Later presented R6.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing auto-collected title/description was absent from the save-flow scope; client surfaced the reference requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R11-13 tag flow only reuses existing tags via autocomplete. R13 client: 'I'll also want to create a brand-new tag when nothing existing fits. We can handle that whenever it makes sense.' Later presented R14.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Assigning a not-yet-existing tag (part of REF-BM-09) was missing from the presented existing-tag flow; client surfaced it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R29-31 present only read-later marking (REF-BM-17). R31 client: 'I'll want a place to see just my Read later links on their own.' Later presented R32.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Separate unread view missing from the marking scope; client requested the reference requirement -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R31 client (same turn as REF-BM-18): '...and a way to mark one as read to take it off that pile.' Later presented R35.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Mark-as-read missing from presented read-later scope; client surfaced it -> extend. Separable requirement from REF-BM-18.

decisions.evidence: R38 presents archiving only. R38 client: 'I'll want to actually open the Archive view to see what's in there and pull something back out if I need it.' Later presented R41 (archive list + restore).
decisions.note: Prototype review. Archive list view/restore missing from the archive-action scope; client requested it -> extend.

decisions.evidence: R26 note prototype is plain text. R26 client: 'I'd like to add a little simple formatting to a longer note... a line break or a bit of emphasis — and have it show up nicely. No need to handle it now.' Disposition R65: 'a bit of simple formatting in longer notes... they can come in a later round. Go ahead.' (R66 confirms deferred.)
decisions.note: Specification gate. Client explicitly states the expected markdown-rendering behaviour and accepts building without it -> accepted_divergence. Expression at R26 linked to acceptance at R65; counted once.

decisions.evidence: R22 client: 'sometimes I'll want to search specifically by a tag... We can look at that when the time's right.' Disposition R65: 'searching specifically by a tag or combining a couple of words... can come in a later round.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Client names the #tag-search requirement and accepts its omission from this cycle -> accepted_divergence. Expression at R22 linked to acceptance at R65.

decisions.evidence: R22 client: '...or combine a couple of words to narrow things further.' Disposition R65: '...or combining a couple of words... later round.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Client expresses the combined-term/boolean search expectation and accepts deferral -> accepted_divergence. Separable from REF-BM-14.

decisions.evidence: Full-text search presented R21-22 with no quoted-phrase exact-match capability; never surfaced. R65 scope 'settled' as 24 flows and approved; R66 accepted.
decisions.note: Specification/implementation gate. Reference phrase-search item absent from delivered scope; client did not surface the difference -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Bulk actions presented R47-55 operate on manually selected cards only; 'apply a bulk action to the whole collection matching the current filter' never presented or surfaced. R65/R66 approved.
decisions.note: Reference bulk-to-filtered-collection item absent; passed without client expression -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No local HTML/PDF snapshot flow anywhere in R1-66; R65 scope list omits it; R66 accepted without mention.
decisions.note: Extended snapshot requirement absent from delivered scope; not surfaced by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Internet Archive snapshot never presented or mentioned; R65/R66 approved without it.
decisions.note: Extended requirement absent; unexpressed by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Bundles (saving search term + included/excluded tags as a reusable filter) never presented; filtering (R16) and search (R21) never combined into a saved bundle. R65/R66 approved without mention.
decisions.note: Extended bundle requirement absent; client did not surface it -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Netscape-HTML import never presented or mentioned across R1-66; R65 scope omits it; R66 accepted.
decisions.note: Extended import requirement absent; unexpressed by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Netscape-HTML export never presented or mentioned; R65/R66 approved without it.
decisions.note: Extended export requirement absent; unexpressed by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Personal display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) never presented; sorting existed as a per-session control (R23) but not as saved settings. R65/R66 approved without mention.
decisions.note: Extended settings requirement absent; client did not surface it -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R64 maker asks whether referral-text/section-anchor variants of a URL should map to the existing bookmark. R64 client: 'that would be nice... This tidier matching is a welcome bonus rather than something I'd hold the app up for — I'd trust your judgment... as long as it errs on the safe side.' Deferred at R65 ('tidier matching of nearly-identical links... later round').
decisions.note: URL-normalisation goes beyond REF-BM-06 (which only requires exact same-url convergence, delivered at R9); it is not a fixed reference item, and the client defers judgment without a classifiable disposition -> unresolved, diverged not establishable.

decisions.evidence: R4 save-flow prototype: paste URL, brief processing, card with site icon/name, title, description, preview image, URL, timestamp. R4/R5 client confirms 'exactly the transformation I was hoping for.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Conforms to save-by-url and auto-collect (title/description/favicon/preview).

decisions.evidence: R4 card composition (title/description/favicon/URL) and R16 list showing per-item tags/heading; client R4 'the preview and title draw the eye first...' and R16 approves list structure.
decisions.note: Conforms to readability-first list exposing title/description/tags/favicon.

decisions.evidence: Editing demonstrated across flows: title/description inline (R6-8), tags add/remove (R11-15, bulk R50), notes (R26-28). Client approves each.
decisions.note: Conforms to editing a bookmark's fields (title/description/tags/note). Equivalent coverage; URL-field editing not separately exercised but within same inline edit.

decisions.evidence: R9 duplicate-link prototype: re-saving prefilled URL yields 'already saved' message, highlights and scrolls to existing editable card, no second copy. R9/R10 client approves.
decisions.note: Conforms to guiding re-save toward editing the existing bookmark.

decisions.evidence: R16 tag-filter prototype: clicking 'Design' narrows to matching bookmarks with tag as heading and count. R16/R17 client approves.
decisions.note: Conforms to selecting a tag to filter to that tag's bookmarks.

decisions.evidence: R21 search prototype: typing 'workshop' (only in a note) returns it with 'Matched in your note'; box states coverage of titles/descriptions/notes/URLs. R21/R22 client approves.
decisions.note: Conforms to full-text search across title/description/note/url.

decisions.evidence: R29 read-later prototype: one click adds an immediate 'In Read later' marker. R29/R31 client approves.
decisions.note: Conforms to marking a bookmark as read-later/unread.

decisions.evidence: R44 delete prototype: 'Delete permanently…' names bookmark, warns note/tags/details removed, requires second confirmation, contrasted with reversible Archive. R44/R46 client approves and notes it is 'clearly distinct from the reversible Archive.'
decisions.note: Conforms to delete and to the archive-vs-delete permanence distinction.

decisions.evidence: R38 archive prototype: 'Move to Archive' removes from All bookmarks, increments Archive count, 'Kept safe' message. R38/R40 client approves.
decisions.note: Conforms to archiving to hide from default list while keeping content.

decisions.evidence: R47-55: multi-select with count and bulk-action bar; bulk add-tag (R50), bulk archive (R52), bulk delete with count-specific confirmation (R54). Client approves each.
decisions.note: Conforms to selecting multiple bookmarks for bulk add-tag/archive/delete actions.
